claim_scope: Finite core quandles of (Z/2^k Z)^d, k>=2 and d>=2, with the canonical affine subgroup; exact ordered-pair orbits and affine-group index.
integrity: Original proof and finite reproducibility code, self-reviewed; no independent audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: No mixed even-modulus classification or splitting theorem. A relevant general 2011 Alexander-quandle automorphism paper could not be inspected in full, creating a risk of implicit prior coverage.
title: Orbit-equivalent affine and full symmetries of even direct-power dihedral quandles
